remarks: Welcome to this bright and inviting side-by-side duplex! Each unit features a spacious living room, dining area, and a sun-filled eat-in kitchen, along with a convenient half bath on the main level. Upstairs, are two generous bedrooms and a full bath. The lower levels offer laundry hookups with washer and dryer, tankless heating systems, ample storage, and direct access to a one-car garage. Unit B requires some TLC, and its current rent is below market value. The tenant is on a month-to-month lease and can vacate if needed. The property is conveniently located near major highways, public transportation, and local amenities. Property is being sold as-is. 24-hour notice required for showings. Go see it today!
